required_forms.where_to_get: HDFC branch — must be collected in person
HDFC branch provides format — executed on stamp paper
required_forms.condition: Required for balances above Rs. 5 lakhs without succession cert

required_documents.doc: Aadhaar of all nominees or legal heirs
PAN of all nominees or legal heirs

required_documents.condition: Mandatory if no nominee registered OR multiple heirs
Required for disputed claims or balance above Rs. 10 lakhs without nominee

procedure_steps: All nominees or legal heirs must be physically present at the HDFC branch together
Carry all original documents and self-attested copies
Collect HDFC deceased claim form from the branch
Fill the form and submit all documents to the branch relationship manager
Bank will initiate internal verification — typically takes 2–3 business days
For joint nominees, bank will split amount as per nomination percentage
Balance transferred to nominee accounts within 20–30 working days
HDFC sends a closure confirmation letter by post
common_rejection_reasons: Not all nominees present at branch on same day
Legal heir certificate not obtained when no nominee registered
Death certificate not certified by municipality

special_cases.multiple_nominees: All nominees must be present together. Bank splits claim per registered nomination ratio.
special_cases.no_nominee_registered: Legal heir certificate mandatory. If heirs dispute, succession certificate from civil court required.
special_cases.locker: Separate process — locker nominee or all legal heirs needed. Inventory required in presence of bank officer.
special_cases.fixed_deposits: Nominee can claim FD payout even if premature — TDS applies. PAN mandatory to avoid 20% TDS.
special_cases.joint_account: Surviving holder operates account. Death certificate submitted for KYC update only.
